description: Core Design System & CSS Architecture Overhaul: Replace dark cinematic theme with clean, minimal, professional design system. Change CSS variables from dark (#050811) to white/light (#FFFFFF, #F8F9FA) backgrounds, dark text (#1A1A1A), and single ocean blue accent (#0EA5E9). Remove neon effects, 3D animations, excessive gradients. Establish consistent card styles, button styles, form field styles, typography scale, and spacing system.
steps: Read src/index.css and identify all dark theme CSS variables (--color-bg-deep, --color-bg-navy, --color-accent-teal, etc.)

Replace CSS variables with new light theme: --color-bg-primary: #FFFFFF, --color-bg-secondary: #F8F9FA, --color-text-primary: #1A1A1A, --color-text-secondary: #4B5563, --color-accent: #0EA5E9, --color-border: #E5E7EB
Update html and body background-color from #050811 to #FFFFFF
Remove all dark Leaflet theme overrides (.leaflet-popup-content-wrapper dark styles, .map-tiles-dark filter) and replace with light theme styles (white popups, light borders, no invert filter)
Remove custom animations (animate-float, animate-pulse-glow) or simplify to subtle transitions only
Remove custom scrollbar dark styling or replace with light gray scrollbar
Define consistent card utility class pattern in CSS or document Tailwind classes: bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl shadow-sm
Define consistent button primary style: bg-blue-500 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-xl hover:bg-blue-600 transition-colors
Define consistent form field style: bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100
Update font imports if necessary (keep existing Google Fonts or use system fonts)
Document new color palette in index.css comments for reference
acceptance_criteria: src/index.css has new CSS variables with white backgrounds and dark text
All dark theme CSS removed (no #050811, #14b8a6 neon colors remain)
Leaflet map styles updated to light theme with proper attribution visible
Running npm run lint passes without errors
Running npm run dev shows a white page background instead of dark
verification: npm run dev and open localhost:3000 in browser
Inspect page background color in DevTools (should be #FFFFFF or #F8F9FA, not #050811)
Scroll page and verify no neon glowing effects or excessive animations
findings: Successfully replaced dark theme (#050811) with clean light theme (white #FFFFFF and #F8F9FA backgrounds, dark text #1A1A1A, ocean blue accent #0EA5E9). Removed all neon effects (teal #14b8a6, cyan #06b6d4), dark Leaflet map filter (.map-tiles-dark), and floating/pulse-glow animations. Updated Leaflet map styles to light theme with white popups, light borders, and proper attribution. Documented complete color system in CSS comments. Build and lint pass successfully. Note: Components still use old dark Tailwind classes (bg-slate-900, text-slate-400, etc.) which will need updating in subsequent features.
